hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his defeat in the Brazilian presidential runoff, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro faced passport seizures and federal police investigation over alleged escape attempts to Argentina, while his party reluctantly recognized the election results.
hotspots.affect: High affective investment driven by election drama, police raids, and intense conspiracy framing around border escapes.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress

hotspots.affect: Fueled by triumphant campaign launch rhetoric, security clampdowns, and polarized debates over her eligibility and platform.

hotspots.title: PP and Vox Pact to Control Spanish Senate
hotspots.blurb: The PP and Vox sealed an electoral pact for the upcoming general elections to avoid competing in key provinces and secure absolute majority control of the Spanish Senate, triggering fierce backlash from the ruling socialist government.
hotspots.affect: Characterized by intense political maneuvering, accusations of destroying democratic centrality, and fierce coalition friction.
